research_info_wall.name: Research information wall
research_info_wall.description: A full-height partition with framed text, a replaceable illustration, a working whiteboard, two markers, eraser and three movable writable sticky notes. Local automatic persistence; gallery, workshop and night styles.
interactions: Grab a marker and touch the whiteboard or a sticky note to write.
Use the eraser to remove local ink.
Grab a sticky note and release it near the wall to pin it.
Ink and note positions persist locally without a save button.
research_info_wall.qfep_connection: A shared surface lets observations persist beside the claims and arrangements that provoked them; visitors can leave a different question without changing the apparatus.
